[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]
== Biography ==
'''John Glasgow''' was recorded at Duddingston on '''11 January 1638'''. The indexed entry names '''Johne Glasgow''' and '''Helene Patoune''', represented by [[Glasgow-3015|John Glasgow]] and [[Patoune-11|Helen Patoune]].<ref name="John1638">National Records of Scotland, Old Parish Registers, Duddingston, parish 684, JOHNE, 11-01-1638, JOHNE GLASGOW/HELENE PATOUNE, FR38; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ Scotland's People]. Indexed child entry cited on this profile; original image not inspected.</ref>

He was probably the '''Jon Glasgow''' recorded four days later, on '''15 January 1638''', in Duddingston's deaths and burials index. That entry includes '''JOHNE GLASGOW''' in its Parents/Other details field, supporting the comparison without explicitly stating the relationship.<ref name="JonBurial1638">National Records of Scotland, Old Parish Registers, deaths and burials, Duddingston, parish 684, reference 60/16, 15 January 1638, JON GLASGOW; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ Scotland's People], exact-surname Glasgow search to 1700, index extract supplied 10 September 2026. Parents/Other details JOHNE GLASGOW; age blank; gender M. Original image not inspected.</ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1084]] is assessed at 63% (probable). The Duddingston Johne child entry dated 11 January 1638 names Johne Glasgow and Helene Patoune. The 1616 Mid Calder child would be about twenty-two at the Duddingston event; the same name and nearby Lothian setting support the proposed adult continuity.

Probable at a modest level for John-1084 specifically; the record father John is explicit, but the childhood-to-adult identification and Patoune/Porteous household continuity remain open.

Next useful test: Compare Duddingston witnesses/residence with the Mid Calder family.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-3014 Duddingston Old Parish Register, parish 684, reference FR38, “JOHNE GLASGOW/HELENE PATOUNE,” entry for Johne, 11 January 1638; citation carried from the former Glasgow-3015 profile. The original page has not been compared with this index wording.]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.


The proposed infant death/burial identification rests on name, parish, associated Johne and the four-day interval. Check the original for a kin term, age or residence before treating this as a proved death or exact death date.

A second '''Jon Glasgow''' entry occurs on '''23 August 1641''', with '''JON GLASGOW''' in the other-details field.<ref name="JonBurial1641">National Records of Scotland, Old Parish Registers, deaths and burials, Duddingston, parish 684, reference 60/24, 23 August 1641, JON GLASGOW; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ Scotland's People], same index extract supplied 10 September 2026. Parents/Other details JON GLASGOW; age blank; gender M. Original image not inspected.</ref> This John and [[Glasgow-1559|John Glasgow]], recorded at Duddingston in April 1639, are chronological candidates for the later entry if the 1638 burial does not belong to this child. The two entries must not be assigned to him simultaneously. No original entry yet resolves the competing identities.

A possible identification concerns Jon Glasgow, Duddingston burial index, 1641. ScotlandsPeople's Church of Scotland Old Parish Registers deaths-and-burials index contains a Duddingston entry dated 23 August 1641 for '''Jon''', with other indexed detail '''Jon Glasgow''' (parish 684, reference 60/24).<ref>Church of Scotland, Old Parish Registers, deaths and burials, Duddingston, JON, other indexed detail JON GLASGOW, 23 August 1641, parish 684, reference 60/24, [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ ScotlandsPeople] index; exact-Glasgow results through 1700 supplied 10 September 2026. The original register image has not been inspected.</ref>

The index does not state an age, residence, parent, spouse, occupation or cause. Its other-name field is preserved as indexed and does not establish a father or any other relationship. Whether the date denotes death, burial or another burial-related entry remains unresolved.

Two existing Duddingston children are possible matches: [[Glasgow-1559|John Glasgow]], recorded born 4 April 1639 to John Glasgow and Margaret Sluman, and [[Glasgow-3014|John Glasgow]], recorded born 11 January 1638 to John Glasgow and Helen Patoune. The name, parish and chronology do not distinguish them. The identification remains uncertain.
